input.expected_problem: Bot may get confused by caller who changes their mind mid-conversation

conversation.content: Hello, this is Monica at Demo Clinic Alpha. How can I help you?
Hi, I think I need to schedule an appointment.
Sure! What would the appointment be for?
Actually, wait. Before I do that - do you know if my lab results are back? I had blood work last week.
I can help you check on that. Were there any specific tests done, or just general blood work?
Hmm, actually never mind the labs. Let me just schedule the appointment. But wait - what are your hours? I need to figure out when I can come in.
Our office hours are Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, and Saturday from 9 AM to 1 PM. We're closed on Sundays. Is there anything else I can help with?
Okay, so you're open until 5. That might work. Actually, can I check on those lab results first after all? Then I'll know if I even need to come in.
Got it! I can help you check on that. Was it just general blood work, or were there specific tests done?
Actually, I changed my mind. I do want to schedule the appointment either way. Sorry, I know I'm all over the place today.
No problem at all! What would the appointment be for?
Sorry, I'm just stressed. Let me focus. I need to: one, check my lab results, and two, schedule a follow-up regardless of the results. Can we do both?
Sure thing! Let me help you with that. First, I can check your lab results. Was it just general blood work, or were there specific tests done?
It was just general blood work. Thank you for your patience!
I will check on your lab results for the general blood work. While I do that, could you please provide me with your full name and date of birth?
Of course! My name is Michelle Lee, and my date of birth is April 22, 1988.

Thank you for your patience, Michelle! I have your lab results request in progress. In the meantime, I have available slots on Tuesday, December 23 at 9:00 AM or Friday, December 26 at 2:00 PM. Which works for you?
Thank you for bearing with me. I know I was confusing. I think I’ll go with Tuesday, December 23 at 9:00 AM for my appointment.
Perfect! Now I just need a few details to complete your booking. I still need a couple of details to finalize your appointment. Can I get your phone number?
Sure! My phone number is 555-666-7777.
Thank you! And could you please provide your email address?
Yes, my email address is mlee@email.com.
Thank you! Let me confirm all the details. Michelle, you're booked for 2025-12-23 at 09:00. Confirmation email to mlee@email.com. Anything else?
No, that sounds good! Just to recap, I’m still waiting on my lab results, right?
Yes, that's correct! You're waiting on your lab results for the general blood work. Would you like me to send you a text? You can reply anytime if questions come up.
Yes, that would be great! I appreciate it. Thank you for your help today!
I'll send you a text right now. You can reply anytime with questions!
